title: First flight, lighter fare
description: Up to 12% off your first domestic search in the demo catalogue, applied to the base fare.
terms: Demo offer only. The discount is illustrative and is not applied to any real transaction. One use per fictional traveller.

title: Weekend hop
description: A flat ₹750 off short-haul weekend routes when both legs are booked in the same search.
terms: Demo offer only. Applies to selected fictional routes and is never charged. Not valid with other demo codes.

title: Business, gently
description: 8% off premium and business cabins on the longer fictional routes in the catalogue.
terms: Demo offer only. Cabin availability is fictional. The discount is shown for learning purposes and is not applied at checkout.

title: Stay two nights, slow down
description: Up to 18% off character-led stays when you book a longer pause in the demo catalogue.
terms: Demo offer only. The saving is illustrative, applies to selected fictional properties, and never creates a booking.

title: Suite Sundays
description: A fictional room upgrade on Sunday arrivals, subject to the property's demo availability.
terms: Demo offer only. Upgrades are fictional and subject to availability that does not exist. No room is held.

title: Long stay, small price
description: 22% off the demo nightly rate when a single stay runs for five nights or more.
terms: Demo offer only. Minimum five nights in the fictional catalogue. The discount is illustrative and not charged.

title: The long-weekend edit
description: A flat ₹3,000 off handpicked three-night escapes in the demo holiday catalogue.
terms: Demo offer only. Applies to selected fictional packages of three nights or fewer. No real trip is booked.

title: Monsoon later
description: 10% off fictional shoulder-season departures, with the same inclusions and no date swap fees.
terms: Demo offer only. Shoulder-season dates are illustrative. The code is never applied to a real payment.

title: Window seat, please
description: A flat ₹300 off selected fictional rail journeys when you pick a window seat.
terms: Demo offer only. Rail inventory is a static shell in this build. The code is illustrative and never charged.

title: Sleeper upgrade
description: A fictional one-class upgrade on overnight routes, subject to demo berth availability.
terms: Demo offer only. Upgrades and berths are fictional. No seat is reserved and no payment is taken.

title: Weekend wheels
description: 15% off fictional self-drive bookings of two days or more in the same demo search.
terms: Demo offer only. Car inventory and pricing are illustrative. The discount is never charged and no vehicle is held.

title: Long road home
description: A flat ₹500 off fictional rentals of five days or more, with unlimited kilometres included in the demo.
terms: Demo offer only. Long-duration availability and kilometre plans are fictional. No car is reserved.
